reconnectIntervalHelp: Wait time between connection attempts after a disconnect
requestTimeoutHelp: Maximum wait time for device responses
channelHelp: Door channel of the door opener (1-based, default 1)
doorIndexHelp: DoorIndex parameter of the door opener (default 0)
shortNumberHelp: ShortNumber parameter of the door opener (default 1)
doorbellEventCodesHelp: Comma-separated list of Dahua event codes that trigger the doorbell state. Common codes: BackKeyLight (VTH), AlarmLocal (doorbell button on VTO), CallDlgStatus (call). Empty = default (BackKeyLight, AlarmLocal).
createEventStates: Create a state per event code
createEventStatesHelp: Automatically creates a state events.<Code> for every received event
